description: Opendata de Grand Paris Sud open data portal is an open data portal listed in Opendata de Grand Paris Sud open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Opendata de Grand Paris Sud. The portal lists 425 datasets published by Opendata de Grand Paris Sud for Grand Paris Sud (Essonne and Seine-et-Marne); the ones about transport, energy, water and digital networks are catalogued as records of their own, the others (population, health, culture, budgets and similar) are outside the scope of this catalogue. Coverage: Grand Paris Sud (Essonne and Seine-et-Marne). 425 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 72 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure data of this area. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-grandparissud-fr-portal.
